about_the_company: BIS Safety Software has been headquartered in Sherwood Park, Alberta, since 2006. We build software that helps organizations manage safety training, learning, and compliance - and we're growing! A few things that make us different: we don't use job titles internally - we value humility and contribution over hierarchy. We move fast, integrate new ideas quickly, and give people real ownership of their work. And through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), you have the opportunity to own a piece of the company you're helping build. BIS Safety Software is a SaaS company on a mission to change how organizations manage safety, learning, and compliance.
position_overview: You'll own the quality, clarity, and consistency of BIS marketing messaging. You will work closely with marketing leadership to understand the companyâs positioning and translate it into clear, compelling copy across a wide range of channels. This includes everything from advertising and website content to buyer guides, campaigns, product messaging, and video scripts.
key_responsibilities: Own Marketing Messaging Quality - ensure consistency of messaging across marketing channels, maintain clarity and discipline in how the company communicates its value, and help refine the language used to describe our platform and capabilities. Develop a Working Understanding of the BIS Platform - write accurate and credible marketing copy. Write and Develop Marketing Content - create and refine copy for a variety of marketing initiatives including website pages and landing pages, digital advertising campaigns, buyer guides and marketing assets, campaign messaging and promotional materials, video scripts and product marketing content, and email campaigns and marketing communications. Understand the Buyer - strong marketing copy requires understanding how buyers think. Work Across Marketing Channels. Use AI as a Professional Tool - AI is increasingly part of modern marketing workflows.
qualifications: Are someone who enjoys thinking deeply about messaging and how customers respond to it. Have 1+ years of professional marketing copywriting experience. Possess a strong ability to translate complex systems into clear messaging. Have excellent judgment about tone, clarity, and positioning. Have an ability to write quickly without sacrificing quality. Thrive working in a fast-paced marketing environment. Have experience using AI tools as part of modern content workflows. Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly. Are humble, eager to learn, and happy to ask questions and seek clarity where needed. Bonus points: Experience writing for SaaS platforms, particularly in safety, compliance, training, or other regulated industries. Familiarity with SEO copywriting principles. Experience writing across multiple formats including landing pages, email campaigns, video scripts, ad copy, and buyer guides.
